name: 張漢利
objective:
本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1-7: Probability
Week 8-11: Discrete random variables and distributions
Week 12-16: Continuous random variables and distributions
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Students will participate in statistics practice workshops designed to reinforce and apply concepts covered in the course. Through guided exercises, practical activities, and discussion, students will strengthen their understanding of statistical concepts and methods and develop their analytical and problem-solving skills.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will complete the statistical exercises and learning activities provided during the workshops. Learning outcomes will be evaluated based on participation, completion of assigned activities, and demonstrated understanding and application of statistical concepts and methods.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          5%

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
